title: Cap. IX Resp. to Minor: God reprobating those in original sin alone does not deal by strict or highest right
pass_a_gloss: As to what pertains to the Minor, I deny also that, that God reprobating deals by strict or highest right with the reprobate, if he reprobate them as lying in original sin alone. If he dealt by highest right with the reprobate, as soon as they were brought forth into light, he could send them away into Gehenna as guilty of eternal death: If he dealt by strict right, he could destitute them of all the gifts of his grace.
pass_b_english: As for the Minor, I also deny that God, when he reprobates, deals with the reprobate by strict or highest right if he reprobates them as lying in original sin alone. If he dealt by highest right, as soon as they were born he could cast them into Gehenna as guilty of eternal death. If he dealt by strict right, he could strip them of all gifts of his grace.
source_text: Ad Minorem quod attinet, nego etiam et illud, Deum reprobantem stricto vel summo jure agere cum reprobis, si eos ut in solo originali peccato jacentes reprobet. Si summo jure ageret cum reprobis, simul ac in lucem editi essent, posset illos ut aeternae mortis reos in gehennam ablegare: Si stricto jure ageret, posset omnibus gratiae suae donis destituere.
